noAccess: No access to DocCheck. Permissions are granted by the superadmin.

notice.title: About DocCheck
notice.body1: Review and session documents are processed only in this browser and never stored. For a review, only excerpts are sent to the AI via the DocCheck proxy.
notice.body2: Master documents can be viewed but not downloaded or printed. This is a usage safeguard, not copy protection. Manufacturers' confidentiality and export-control notices still apply.
notice.sandbox: Sandbox: the library is synthetic, AI calls are simulated and free of charge.

review.drop: Drop a review document here (PDF, DOCX, XLSX)
review.hint: The formal check will run automatically after parsing (phase 8). Documents stay only in this tab's memory.

library.readonly: Read-only: the library is maintained by the superadmin and DocCheck admins.
library.selectionHint: {{n}} selected for this review · applies to your session only

session.drop: Additional master document for this session only
session.hint: Not stored; marked as “Session document – not released” in the report.

pruefung.kontextPh: e.g. Reference configuration: CL30, HTF7350, avionics software 3305.02; mark options as “(optional)”
pruefung.name: Name
pruefung.kostenBereit: Calculated before the start and must be confirmed.
pruefung.kostenFehlt: No prices maintained for {{modell}} yet. Without prices there is no estimate and no start.
pruefung.formalAus: The formal check has been switched off by the superadmin.

findings.empty: No findings yet. They appear with the first review run.

chat.off: The Q&A chat has been switched off by the superadmin.
chat.hint: Ask in German or English about the selected documents. Every answer cites its sources as [document, rev, page] with a jump to the viewer.

rev.dokumente: The revision history of reviewed documents appears here once a review state is loaded.

export.language: Exports are always labelled in English; quotations stay in the original.

verwalten.revision: Upload a new revision (the old one is archived)

admin.featuresHint: Take effect immediately, without a new version. Turning off “DocCheck overall” shows the maintenance notice on the tile.
admin.realAiHint: Available once the proxy is in place (phase 1b).
admin.proxyTestHint: Reads the response stream in Messages API format through the same parser as in production. In the sandbox the response is fixed; no document content leaves the browser.
admin.auditEmpty: No entries yet. Every change to a DocCheck permission or setting is logged here.
admin.risk1: View without download is a usage safeguard, not copy protection.
admin.risk2: OEM confidentiality and export control must be cleared before the first upload to the library.
admin.risk3: Data processing: DPAs with Supabase and Anthropic are a precondition for production use.
admin.errorProbeHint: Deliberately triggers an error in the DocCheck module. Expected: a message with an error code, all other tiles keep working.

mobile.desktopOnly: Reviews and library maintenance on desktop or laptop
mobile.startOnDesktop: Start the re-check on a desktop
mobile.openState: Open a review state file (.doccheck.json), view and export findings.
mobile.chatLimit: Q&A chat against selected library documents, at most 3,000 pages at a time.

upload.formate: PDF, DOCX, XLSX · up to 500 MB · drag & drop works too

duplikat.gleicheRevision: Same number and revision as {{mit}} ({{wo}}), but different content

fehler.DC-PARSE: The file could not be read.
fehler.DC-FORMAT: Format not recognised — PDF, DOCX or XLSX?
fehler.DC-PDF-INVALID: The PDF is damaged or incomplete.

ocr.frage_one: 1 page has no text layer (scan). Start text recognition? Takes a few seconds.
ocr.frage_other: {{count}} pages have no text layer (scan). Start text recognition? Takes a few seconds per page.

viewer.fehler: The page could not be displayed.

suche.platzhalter: e.g. BATT 1 OFF BUS, AMC1 ORA.ATO.230, 155 KIAS
suche.keineDokumente: Upload a review or session document first.
suche.hinweis_one: Searches 1 loaded document. CAS messages, numbers with units and rule IDs are matched exactly. The library joins in phase 3.
suche.hinweis_other: Searches {{count}} loaded documents. CAS messages, numbers with units and rule IDs are matched exactly. The library joins in phase 3.
